The five places to see in Jaipur are Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Nahargarh Fort. Hawa Mahal, City Palace and Jantar Mantar sit close together in the old city, so you can walk between them. The map shows rough positions only, with no street map behind it.
